map: aml-substrate capability C-code -> signal-watch legacy TM-### rule id(s)
purpose: The namespace adoption seam (Phase 62). The grounded substrate probe-history carries capability C-codes as rule_id; signal-watch's §12 silent_rules metric (and the candidate §14 re-curation) speak legacy TM-### rule ids. Each substrate per-account detector capability maps to the legacy TM rule(s) that express it, or an explicit honest-null where the legacy rulebook authored no rule for that capability.

grounding.direction: C-code -> TM rule(s); derived by INVERTING the rulebook's per-rule capability field (every listed TM's rulebook capability == the C-code key — validated by --selftest)

semantics: A fired C-code marks ALL its mapped TM rules as capability-covered (not silent). silent_rules in the GROUNDED world is therefore CAPABILITY-level silence: a legacy TM rule whose capability never fired in the grounded history — NOT rule-variant-level silence. The substrate detects at capability granularity (one C-code detector), not per-TM-rule-variant, so it cannot distinguish TM-107 from TM-109 (both C3). This is a MEASURED definitional adaptation from the synthetic fixture's rule-id-native silence to capability-native silence — surfaced, never hidden.

honest_nulls.C15: Beneficial-ownership / shell-front-company & nominee-network analysis. The substrate's per-account monitoring fires this capability, but the legacy Northbridge TM rulebook authored NO rule for it — a genuine coverage finding (the substrate capability is AHEAD of the legacy rulebook). Surfaced as an explicit null; never silently dropped.

scope_note: Covers the 6 per-account detector capabilities the substrate projector can emit to the probe-history (C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C15). Screening capabilities (C7, C8, C14, C26) are NOT emitted to the per-account probe-history (they flow to evidence bundles) and are out of this map's scope.
provenance: signal-watch Phase 62 T2 (2026-06-20); substrate pin aml-substrate@ae98924 (P22). Grounded against the committed rulebook + taxonomy; closed-vocab + inversion-faithfulness asserted by `python3 scripts/probe_history_stats.py --selftest`.
